verification_method: live web retrieval of specified primary/official pages; access limits retained

sources.title: Essentials of Strength Training and Conditioning, 5th Edition
sources.access_scope: official introduction and table of contents
sources.supports: 需求分析、训练、评估、营养和恢复的知识结构
sources.does_not_support: 未读全书；目录不是特定剂量或精细机制的证据

sources.title: Developing Power, 2nd Edition
sources.access_scope: publisher introduction and table of contents
sources.supports: 功率评估、计划、专项应用架构
sources.does_not_support: 不复制付费书完整计划，不承诺精确效果

sources.title: Fundamentals of Power Development
sources.supports: 力量与较高速度输出结合；力速关系
sources.does_not_support: 不把高级复合训练门槛套给初级跳跃，不推算未测RFD/瓦数

sources.title: Resistance Training Prescription for Muscle Function, Hypertrophy, and Physical Performance in Healthy Adults: An Overview of Reviews
sources.access_scope: PubMed abstract and official announcement; not full paper
sources.supports: 力量、肌肥大、功率处方重点不同，复杂编排/力竭并非普遍必要；检索截止2024年10月
sources.does_not_support: 群体结论不能给出个体最优剂量

sources.title: Plyometric Training
sources.supports: 伸缩循环和不同跳跃/抛掷任务的机制例子
sources.does_not_support: 该页面没有给本方案接触次数；本方案剂量为个体编排，不冒称来源证明

sources.title: The Resistance Training Dose Response: Meta-Regressions Exploring the Effects of Weekly Volume and Frequency on Muscle Hypertrophy and Strength Gains
sources.supports: 组数收益递减，直接和间接组应区分，力量/体积的剂量关系不同
sources.does_not_support: 0.5间接组是统计近似，不是个人刺激系数或MRV测量

sources.title: Exploring the Dose–Response Relationship Between Estimated Resistance Training Proximity to Failure, Strength Gain, and Muscle Hypertrophy
sources.access_scope: publisher abstract; PubMed page unavailable in this run
sources.supports: 接近力竭和肌肥大存在关系，力量关系不同
sources.does_not_support: 探索性回归和估计RIR，不能定唯一最佳RIR或每组失败

sources.title: Progression Models in Resistance Training for Healthy Adults
sources.access_scope: PubMed index/abstract retrieved initially; later fetch limited
sources.does_not_support: 旧文件结合新证据；连续两次、档位上限等是本模块操作规则

sources.title: Effects of Periodization on Strength and Muscle Hypertrophy in Volume-Equated Resistance Training Programs
sources.supports: 等量条件周期化对力量和肌肥大影响不同
sources.does_not_support: 不能保证复杂周期对本人最好；1RM结果不等于全部目标

sources.title: Novel Resistance Training-Specific Rating of Perceived Exertion Scale Measuring Repetitions in Reserve
sources.does_not_support: 不是每组客观测量，不把整场疲劳填为组RPE

sources.title: International Society of Sports Nutrition Position Stand: protein and exercise
sources.access_scope: open position summary and protein intake/distribution sections
sources.supports: 多数运动者全天1.4–2.0g/kg参考；分配和食物/补充关系
sources.does_not_support: 本模块1.6–2.0范围为个体选择，不是本人已摄入量

sources.title: Effect of Small and Large Energy Surpluses on Strength, Muscle, and Skinfold Thickness in Resistance-Trained Individuals
sources.access_scope: public abstract, conclusions and stated limitations
sources.supports: 快速增重不等于更多肌肉，摄入调整宜保守
sources.does_not_support: 样本与8周条件有限；150–200kcal和0.1%–0.25%为操作选择，非该试验证明

sources.title: Fluid Replacement for the Physically Active
sources.supports: 结合出汗、环境、时长和耐受个体化补液，避免不足与过量
sources.does_not_support: 不设统一4升；日常疲劳不诊断脱水

sources.title: Accuracy in Predicting Repetitions to Task Failure in Resistance Exercise
sources.supports: RIR预测有误差和明显个体/条件差异
sources.does_not_support: 不能否定主观反馈或要求常规失败测试

sources.title: Nutrition and Athletic Performance
sources.authors_or_organization: Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics / Dietitians of Canada / ACSM
sources.access_scope: access_limited: page had no readable abstract/body
sources.supports: 保留待核验营养背景条目，本次不用于精确处方
sources.does_not_support: 未读表格不提取碳水、脂肪或补液配额

sources.title: Resistance training-induced changes in integrated myofibrillar protein synthesis are related to hypertrophy only after attenuation of muscle damage
sources.supports: 损伤修复与长期肌肥大适应不能等同，初期合成反应不能直接预测增长
